name: Edna
tagline: Dresses you each morning from the clothes already hanging in your closet
description: It starts from photos of the clothes you already own, assembling each day's main look plus a backup, and its critique of whatever you send is unflinching. A few high-wear gaps worth filling get named, and every purchase waits for your approval.
author: congressdj
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
